description: Create temp doc, add rectangle, read geometry, close without saving; snapshot returned
source: var before = app.documents.length; var d = app.documents.add(); try { var r = d.pathItems.rectangle(100, 100, 50, 30); var g = r.geometricBounds; var snap = {docsBefore: before, docs: app.documents.length, items: d.pageItems.length, bounds: [g[0], g[1], g[2], g[3]], width: r.width, typename: r.typename}; return snap; } finally { try { d.close(SaveOptions.DONOTSAVECHANGES); } catch(e){} }
